source_document.title: Emerging Tech: AI Vendor Race: Startups to Watch in Synthetic Population and Behavioral Simulation

recovery_state.visibility_bias: Vendors that publish recognition posts are easier to recover than vendors that remain silent. The recovery set is therefore non-random and cannot support prevalence, absence, tier-share, or market-coverage calculations.

recovery_batches.interpretation: An access and public-recovery receipt, not a frozen denominator.
One later public recovery is recorded by the issue but is not transcribed into this ledger until its identity and source fields are durably recovered.

prohibited_uses: Do not use the recovery candidates as the vendor denominator.
Do not compute prevalence, market share, tier distribution, inclusion rates, or absence from this recovery set.
Do not treat a vendor self-report as independent confirmation of the analyst roster or methodology.
Do not infer capability, quality, endorsement, procurement suitability, investment merit, deployment, or scientific validity from inclusion.
Do not infer a tier when the public receipt states only that a vendor was named or watched.

required_fields: all watched vendor legal or stable public identities
all report tier labels exactly as published
explicit reconciliation against public self-reports and commentary
human review of every identity and tier

next_actions: Obtain authorized subscriber access or a licensed artifact for Gartner document 7718657.
Transcribe all 33 watched vendors, tier labels, page or section spans, and method language.
Resolve the one later public recovery reported by issue #38 but not yet transcribed into this ledger.
Reconcile every public claim against the licensed source and preserve conflicts, omissions, and withdrawals.
Only after human review set usable_as_denominator to true and begin cross-vendor evidence acquisition.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A source-custody and recovery ledger for building a neutral vendor denominator.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: The Gartner roster, an independent confirmation of vendor inclusion or tier, a capability ranking, a market census, a finding, or evidence of absence.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: The visible vendor names are a biased public recovery set, not the denominator. Public self-reports show that a vendor claimed recognition; they do not independently establish the complete analyst roster, tier, capability, quality, endorsement, deployment, market prevalence, or absence of vendors that did not publish.
